# Dubbo Asbestos Removal

> Asbestos removal in Dubbo, Wellington and surrounds. Free quotes from one licensed local removalist for fibro, asbestos roofs, farm sheds and testing.

Dubbo Asbestos Removal (dubboasbestosremoval.com) is a free asbestos removal quote and referral service, not a removal company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form and the request goes to one licensed local asbestos removalist, who quotes and does the work.

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Dubbo Asbestos Removal cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take asbestos removal quote requests from Dubbo and nearby areas, including West Dubbo, South Dubbo, East Dubbo, Delroy Park, Keswick Estate, Southlakes Estate, Narromine, Brocklehurst, Wongarbon, Eumungerie, Mogriguy, Ballimore, Rawsonville, Toongi, Wellington, Geurie, Stuart Town. Our quote service is free, with no call-out fee from us. Some removalists charge for an inspection or call-out to rural properties, so ask before they visit. Roofs, high walls and rural properties out towards Toongi or Eumungerie can add time, travel and equipment.
- **Does asbestos removal need a licence or permit?** Yes for most jobs. In NSW, a homeowner may remove up to 10 m² of bonded asbestos following SafeWork NSW guidance. More than 10 m² of bonded asbestos needs a Class B or Class A licensed removalist, and any friable asbestos needs a Class A licence. Licensed removalists must notify SafeWork NSW at least 5 calendar days before licensed work starts. A householder transporting more than 100 kg or 10 m² of asbestos waste must report it to the NSW EPA within 24 hours of delivery. Ask every removalist for their licence number.
- **What affects the price of asbestos removal?** The type and amount of asbestos (bonded sheeting is usually simpler than friable material), access (roofs, eaves, wet areas and rural sites take longer), and extras such as lab testing, tip fees for wrapped asbestos, air monitoring and clearance certificates. We don't publish prices. Tell us about your job and a licensed local removalist will quote for it, ideally after seeing the job or photos.
- **Who does the removal?** Dubbo Asbestos Removal is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't remove asbestos ourselves. We pass your request to one licensed local removalist, who quotes and does the work.
